name: @superschematic/schema-runtime
description: Schema runtime for TypeScript: JSON/YAML schema reader and writer, IR reader, parse, validate, mask, merge, over the superscalar scalar functions. Needs superscalar and @superschematic/schema-ir next to it in node_modules; see scripts/link-local-deps.mjs.

scripts.build: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/fix-esm-extensions.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && node test/ir-reader.cjs && node test/field-length-parity.cjs && node test/parse-registry-datetime.cjs && node test/parse-registry-names.cjs && node test/parse-registry-json.cjs
